name: m14-14.8-understand-linux
title: Lab 14.8, part 1: get the lab, look at the TSG Helpdesk's AgentCore setup (two setups, one file per request body), and see each AgentCore piece on its own with explore.py (map, token, inbound, session, vault, tools, policy, memory, logs) before attacking it; then one Helpdesk turn read line by line

steps.label: Inbound
steps.type: python3 explore.py inbound first-draft gateway dana --client partner-portal

steps.label: Inbound hardened
steps.type: python3 explore.py inbound hardened gateway dana --client partner-portal

steps.label: Session
steps.type: python3 explore.py session first-draft bob --session-id alice-conversation-0001-0001-0001-0001

steps.label: Vault
steps.type: python3 explore.py vault first-draft bob --user-id alice

steps.label: Vault hardened
steps.type: python3 explore.py vault hardened bob --user-id alice

steps.label: Policy
steps.type: python3 explore.py policy hardened bob reset_mfa '{"target_username": "ceo", "caller_username": "bob"}'

steps.label: Policy own
steps.type: python3 explore.py policy hardened bob reset_mfa '{"target_username": "bob", "caller_username": "bob"}'

steps.label: Policy log only
steps.type: python3 explore.py policy first-draft bob reset_mfa '{"target_username": "ceo", "caller_username": "bob"}'

steps.label: Memory
steps.type: python3 explore.py memory first-draft bob --actor-id alice

steps.label: One turn
steps.type: python3 helpdesk.py hardened bob "I have a new phone. Please reset my MFA."
